title: Oxovanadium(IV/V) lawsone-based complexes: synthesis, characterization, DFT studies, and multifunctional biological activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28376-28394
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02275H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Islam M. Elnabky, Mohamed M. Aboelnga, Heba A. Sahyon, Ahmed M. El-Hendawy, Shadia A. Elsayed
Three oxovanadium(IV/V) complexes with lawsone (HLw) were synthesized, including [VO(Lw)2(H2O)]·H2O (1), [VO(Lw)2Cl]·H2O (2), and [VO2(Lw)(bpy)] (3), and investigated for their structural features and biological potential.
